I couldn't find any evidence that Narain Karthikeyan drove for a team in 2012. My searches returned 2012 race reports (Malaysia, China, Canada, Germany, Hungary, Japan, Singapore, Korea, India, Abu Dhabi) and none listed him in the top 10. Those reports only cover top-10 finishers, so his absence is not conclusive, and the search didn't surface any 2012 standings or team listing for him. My searches also didn't turn up any reference to his HRT seat, so I can't confirm a team from this data.

ANSWER: none
